newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber unchanged in dull late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber unchanged in dull late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged late on Friday after poor consumer demand, traders said.
"Sentiment has not changed since this morning. It's very boring and there is no trading at all," said one trader.

Traders said the SIR20 March price was unchanged at 53.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang, down from 54.00 on Thursday. In Medan, offer prices were quoted at 53.75, down from 54.00 and in Surabaya, traders offered SIR20 at 53.625, down from 54.00 on Thursday.
Traders said market was quiet in the absence of buyers.

Traders said offer prices were quoted at 53.625 U.S. cents/lb, which was lower than Thursday's levels of 54.125 fob Padang. In Pontianak and Jambi, traders offered SIR20 at 53.25-50, down from 53.75 on the previous day.
Traders said the market lacked of direction which made it difficult for them to quote the price.
"It's hard to quote for the price because we are still wondering why no buyers enter the market yet," said one trader.
Traders reported sporadic U.S. buying lifted the price slightly on Thursday but said there were no fresh deals coming to the market on Friday.
Some traders said they learned production activity had started to resume in the U.S. after the winter month, but added it had not made any change to local market sentiment.
Traders earlier predicted they might end up selling SIR20 at 53.00 U.S. cents/lb as the market lacked any fresh factors to boost the prices.
They said they expected market sentiment to remain poor next week because of the absence of buyers.
